en.titre:
HOW TO LOOK
MORE ATTRACTIVE
WITHOUT TRYING.

en.texte: Shower, deodorant, one spray of cologne. Clean beats strong every time.
Short and clean, always. People notice your hands more than you think.
No gym needed to look fit. A running coach app like Atala builds your plan around the days you can run.
A simple watch makes any outfit look finished. No logo, no noise.
A fresh cut every few weeks keeps you sharp, even in a plain t-shirt.
